title: chore(pm-dispatch): L2 contract review runs at high, on the review sweep readings
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XEj2DWDMnuvddhRR7m3AuUP)_

Part of #35270

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: ruling record 7073045669 on #35270, point 4 (the maintainer's 「B 只测审核这一项」, 2026-11-22 02:38Z): "recall at `high` not below recall at `xhigh` means the line goes to `high`; otherwise it stays `xhigh`. That change is a governed PR and goes to the maintainer." The readings and the maintainer's 「C」 (2026-11-22 03:36Z, to the option 「C 到此为止，按 10 次的读数定」) are measurement record 7073679594 on #35270.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:产品用户无感;合并前的契约审核(L2)从 xhigh 改为 high,每次审核大约快三分之一、省三分之一 token。
- 为什么做:#35270 的审核实测(10 次)里,high 找到旧审核主要问题 13/18,xhigh 10/18,5 个 PR 没有一个是 xhigh 更多;按卡上规则改 high。
- 出错会怎样:只改一行规则文字;若之后发现 high 漏得多,改回这一行即可。
- 要你做什么：这是受治理的规则改动（Tier H），按你选的 C 交你批准后合并。L1 ACCEPT 7073925159，契约 PASS 7073840983（head 68838fd8）。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` line 128, in place:

- Before: `此外只有 L2 审核/四轴分析/ADR/红线复读与高危公告修复 diff 复核 \`xhigh\`;两条压过尺寸行。`
- After: `此外只有四轴分析/ADR/红线复读与高危公告修复 diff 复核 \`xhigh\`,L2 审核 \`high\`;两条压过尺寸行。`

L2 review leaves the `xhigh` list and is named at `high` on the same line. This includes the per-head reviewer subagent, which is where the level is spent. Nothing else in the `xhigh` list moves:
- four-axis analysis;
- ADR work, held by the standing order on line 101, which changes only on the maintainer's own word;
- the red-line re-read (decision 二 of ruling record 7024443457);
- the read-only diff review of a high-severity advisory fix (the security sweep was not run, ruling 7073045669 point 3).

`lanes/l2-review.md` line 7 already holds the L2 seat session at `high` and names no separate level for the reviewer, so it is not edited. A grep of `.claude/**`, `skills/**` and `docs/qa/**` finds no other line that puts L2 review at `xhigh`.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `execution-duties.md` row moves 20148 → 20154 bytes, the measured delta of this edit (+6). The row comment names 7073679594 a "ruling record"; it is the measurement record, and the ruling is record 7073045669 (point 4). The comment wording is left as it is so the head does not move.

## Why

The effort rule kept L2 review at `xhigh` until #35270's review sweep measured it (`execution-duties.md` line 138: effort values come from this repository's own measurements). Measurement record 7073679594:

- 5 old L2 heads with known findings, one fresh read-only contract-tier subagent per run, given only a throwaway checkout and the PR body as it stood.
- Major-finding recall: 13/18 at `high`, 10/18 at `xhigh`. `high` was not below `xhigh` at any head: 2 ties, 3 heads where `high` found more.
- Nits: 5/14 at `high`, 3/14 at `xhigh`.
- Extra findings: 33 at `high`, 37 at `xhigh`. False findings: 0 at `high`, 1 at `xhigh`.
- Cost: `xhigh` took a mean 25.8 minutes against 16.6, and +52% output tokens.
- Where `xhigh` did better: it graded one known security-relevant finding at should-fix, where `high` named the same finding as a nit.
- The maintainer chose to settle on these 10 runs rather than the 30 approved: 「C」.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`: exit 0. `execution-duties.md is 20154 bytes (ceiling 20154; headroom 0)`.
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: 116 cases pass.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`: exit 0, 131 files clean.
- `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`: exit 0.
- The derived family list (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 41 commands) at head `68838fd8`: 39 exit 0.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`: exit 3, NOT MEASURED (prerequisite: lint and formula are not built in this checkout). CI runs it.
  - `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`: exit 1, pre-existing. The `--self-test` battery "#11705 end to end, against the REAL generator" registers 5 cases against a floor of 7; the same failure reproduces on `origin/main` without this change.

No changeset: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` are not published (`skip-changeset`).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` was not run locally (rule text only); CI runs it.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 速读 block is the maintainer's channel)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
